title: PHP Modernization Project Profile
description: Output schema for skills/php-modernization/scripts/introspect.py — cheap first-touch project shape (no subprocess invocations beyond `php --version`).

project_root.description: Absolute path to the analyzed project root.

php_version_constraint.description: From composer.json config.platform.php OR require.php; "unknown" when neither is set.

php_runtime.description: Detected PHP runtime version (e.g. "8.4.5") parsed from the first line of `php --version`, or "unknown" if php is missing or the output is not parseable.

tooling.description: Boolean fingerprints for known tools. Detection is best-effort (substring match against composer.json/composer.lock).

phpcs.description: squizlabs/php_codesniffer in composer.json/lock, or a PHPCS config file.

fractor.description: a9f/fractor or a9f/typo3-fractor in composer.json/lock (non-PHP migrations: Fluid, TypoScript, XML, YAML).

phpunit.description: phpunit/phpunit in composer.json/lock, or a PHPUnit config file.

php_linter.description: php-parallel-lint/php-parallel-lint or overtrue/phplint in composer.json/lock. False means `php -l`.

config_files.description: First existing config file per tool, relative to the project root; null when none of the known paths exists.

coding_standard.description: Which coding-standard tool the project configures. The skill uses that one and does not ask for the other.

source_dirs.description: Existing directories from composer.json autoload (src) and autoload-dev (tests): psr-4, psr-0 and classmap. Falls back to src/Classes and tests/Tests when composer declares none.

project_commands.description: The project's own entry points, read from files and never executed. Prefer these over bare vendor/bin calls: they carry the runtime, config and paths.

composer_scripts.description: Script names in composer.json, in file order.

includes.description: True when the Makefile has an include line; the included targets are not listed.

autoload_psr4.description: Mirror of composer.json::autoload.psr-4 (namespace → path or paths). Empty object if missing.

phpstan.description: True if a phpstan-baseline.neon is present at any common path.

psalm.description: True if a psalm-baseline.xml is present at any common path.
